name: (05) Animalism — 3 Advanced — Drawing Out the Beast

system.description:
Your mastery of the Beast Within is so complete that, poised on the very brink of frenzy, you can wrench your own fury free and cast it into another to rage in your place.

You must be on the verge of frenzy. In place of any Virtue Test to control it, make a Social Challenge against anyone within your line of sight; this costs no action and may be attempted whenever you are about to frenzy. Win and your frenzy passes to the victim, who frenzies at once and even manifests your mannerisms and speech, while you remain calm and unable to frenzy for the duration; lose and you frenzy immediately with no Virtue Test and cannot resist it with Willpower. Animals and ghouls are favored targets, but anyone may be struck. If the victim dies while frenzied the Beast rushes back to you, forcing a Virtue Test or another use of this power; if the victim leaves your sight before the frenzy ends you suffer as though Quelled — no Willpower Traits and Submissive x2 — until you recover your Beast or the victim dies. Retest with Animal Ken.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
